name: Spotify Web API
tagline: Programmatic access to Spotify catalog, playback, and user library data.
description: Spotify Web API lets developers query music metadata, manage playlists, control playback on Spotify clients, and access user library and recommendations. OAuth 2.0 is required for user data and most write actions; client credentials cover catalog-only reads. Official docs and developer dashboard are the source of truth for scopes, endpoints, and app registration.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code (with PKCE recommended) or Client Credentials; Bearer token in Authorization header. Register an app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard for client ID/secret.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No separate per-call API fee. Free app registration with Development Mode defaults: app owner must have an active Spotify Premium subscription; max 5 allowlisted authenticated users; subject to per-developer quota and 429/Retry-After rate limits. Extended quota mode is available via application (often organization-oriented); commercial use per Spotify Developer Terms.

rate_limits: not published as fixed global numbers; 429 with Retry-After when exceeded; per-app quotas may apply

get track metadata and audio features
list and manage a user's playlists
get currently playing track for a user
create a playlist and add tracks
fetch artist top tracks or related artists
